name: Auto Parts Company Of St Louis
old_description: Auto Parts Company specializes in late model salvage: foreign and domestic cars, light trucks, and vans. Our facilities are just outside the St. Louis Metropolitan area in Moscow Mills, Missouri. As well as Joplin on Hwy 43, and St James located on I44 between St. Louis and Springfield.
about:
Auto Parts Company of St. Louis operates from its primary facility in Moscow Mills, Missouri, just outside the St. Louis metropolitan area, with additional locations in Joplin on Highway 43 and St. James on I-44. The company has been in business for decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed.

The company specializes in late-model salvage, dismantling foreign and domestic cars, light trucks, and vans to supply recycled and aftermarket parts, rebuilders, and whole late-model vehicles. It maintains three locations and offers online parts ordering with search by make, model, part number, or VIN. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Auto Parts Company serves automotive repair shops, collision centers, and individual customers across the Midwest and nationwide. It ships via UPS or common carrier throughout the United States and provides free delivery to a broad corridor including St. Louis, Hannibal, Quincy, Columbia, Jefferson City, Rolla, Springfield, Joplin, Branson, Fayetteville, Tulsa, and Bentonville.

The company emphasizes its 90-day warranty on all parts, decades of customer-service experience, and a multi-location network as key differentiators. It was built to provide both the part and the support needed for automotive repair.
